name: schemastud/laravel-json-ns
description: The Laravel binding for the @namespace grammar — a URI-keyed dispatch socket over schemastud/php-json-ns + rushing/php-popcorn: bind your own namespace URI to your own handler (registered as a popcorn Invocable), with pick-one-by-URI (pinned > stem) resolution and a no-op-after-validation fallback.

package-topology.because: The Laravel binding is the tier where the popcorn coupling rides: it wires the framework-free @namespace grammar (schemastud/php-json-ns) into the popcorn InvocableRegistry (rushing/php-popcorn) as a URI-keyed dispatch socket. Neither dependency may be dropped — the grammar has no dispatch, the registry has no namespace resolution; this package is exactly their join (asset 06 §8).
